items.title: Muse – Meta’s personal AI agent
items.why: Meta is building a personal AI agent called Muse, which is directly relevant to your interest in AI agents.
items.summary: Muse is Meta's new personal AI agent designed to help users manage daily tasks and automated workflows.

items.title: Desert Ant Labs: local, fast models that run on device
items.why: On-device AI models allow you to run fast, private machine learning tasks directly on your laptop without API fees.
items.summary: Desert Ant Labs released compact AI models optimized to run locally on personal hardware with high speed and low resource usage.

items.title: A new Anthropic model seeks to test how AI could impact the U.S. economy
items.why: Anthropic created an interactive model allowing you to explore how AI automation could impact jobs and the economy.
items.summary: Anthropic built a web simulation tool that lets users test different economic scenarios regarding the impact of modern AI.

items.title: vinzdg/codenotch
items.why: This utility lets you easily monitor your API usage and limits across AI development tools like Claude and Cursor.
items.summary: Codenotch is a macOS menu bar utility that displays real-time rate limit usage for major AI coding assistants.

items.title: okf-memory/okf-agent-memory
items.why: This open-source tool helps AI coding agents store long-term context while drastically cutting token costs.
items.summary: OKF Agent Memory provides a fast, Git-native memory system for AI coding assistants to retain context efficiently across sessions.

items.title: i-am-manware/Manware-s-AI-Learning-Toolkit
items.why: This toolkit turns AI agents into interactive coding tutors tailored to help you learn software development faster.
items.summary: An open-source project designed to transform AI agents into interactive teachers that guide you through coding concepts step-by-step.

items.title: Shopify acquires Tailwind
items.why: Tailwind CSS is a fundamental tool in web development, making its acquisition by Shopify important developer news.
items.summary: Shopify has acquired Tailwind Labs, bringing the team behind the wildly popular utility-first CSS framework into its platform.

items.title: Claude, change the “Add to Cart” button to blue
items.why: This discussion highlights how natural language commands with modern AI are changing real-world web development.
items.summary: A look into how developers are using LLM tools like Claude to modify user interface code directly using simple English instructions.

items.title: Understanding the recent DDoS attack against Read the Docs
items.why: Read the Docs hosts documentation for thousands of Python libraries you will use during your CS studies.
items.summary: An engineering postmortem analyzing a major cyberattack against Read the Docs and explaining how the team restored services.

items.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
items.why: The ongoing US-Canada trade conflict has major economic ramifications for trade and global supply chains.
items.summary: The United States announced new import bans on Canadian products following counter-tariffs imposed by Canada.
